title: Curvature and Normal Vectors of a Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Curvature of a Space Curve
definitions.statement: Curvature kappa is the rate at which the unit tangent vector T changes direction per unit of arc length s. It measures how sharply the curve bends at each point.
definitions.explanation: Straight lines have kappa = 0 everywhere; a circle of radius a has constant curvature kappa = 1/a.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Radius of curvature rho = 1/kappa is the radius of the osculating (best-fit) circle.

definitions.title: Principal Normal and Binormal Vectors (TNB Frame)
definitions.statement: The principal unit normal vector N points in the direction that T is turning (toward the inside of the curve). The binormal vector B is a unit vector orthogonal to both T and N, completing the right-handed Frenet-Serret orthonormal TNB frame.
definitions.explanation: The plane spanned by T and N is the osculating plane; T and B span the rectifying plane; N and B span the normal plane.
definitions.keyTakeaway: The TNB frame forms a moving orthogonal coordinate system traveling along the trajectory.
